The local bar introduces new 80-proof barley wine. Locals mistake it for regular beer. DWI incidents skyrocket.
You buy your first hearse at a police auction. It still has the cage in the back.
The landlord says the smell is "either you or the building". It's both.
You teach Morty to wave from the front window. Foot traffic doubles. Foot traffic was one guy.
You can't afford a real embalming table, so you use the dining table. Dinner parties are cancelled indefinitely.
`4The power company shuts off your electricity. `$The cooler warms up. So does the smell.
You find a dead raccoon in the crawlspace and bill the county for "removal of remains". They pay.
Your mortuary science correspondence course arrives. Lesson one: "Which End Is The Head?" You get an A.
You practice your sad face in the mirror for an hour. The mirror looks sadder.
`4Your hearse's muffler falls off `$on Main Street during a procession. The mourners pick up the pace.
Elijah at Di-Mart lets you have a dented casket for half price. He doesn't say what dented it.
You mix up two toe tags. Nobody notices. You decide this means you have a gift.
`4A raccoon moves into the display casket. `$It hisses at anyone who asks about financing.
You hang a GRAND OPENING banner over the CONDEMNED notice. Classy.
Father Smyth drops by to bless the building. He sprinkles holy water, sniffs, and sprinkles a lot more.
Your mother calls to ask when you'll get a real job. You tell her you're in the people business.
You find a quarter in a dead man's ear. You check the other ear. A dime. Things are looking up.
`4The bank repossesses your good chair. `$Customers will now be grieving on a milk crate.
You discover embalming fluid makes a passable window cleaner. Also floor cleaner. Also hair gel.
Morty falls out of the closet during a viewing. You tell the family he's staff. They tip him.
You sleep in the display casket to save on rent. Best night's sleep you've had in years.
A stray dog adopts the parlor and buries things in the back yard. Some of them were yours.
`4Your FuneralManager (TM) free trial expires `$and locks every file behind a pop-up asking for money. Relatable.
Neighborhood kids hold a seance on your lawn. They summon nothing but the police.
You win a wheelbarrow of slightly used flowers in the cemetery lost-and-found raffle.
`4You buy embalming fluid in bulk from a man in a van. `$Half of it is lemonade.
The sign painter spells it FUNREAL HOME. You lean into it and add balloons.
The Nurse pins your flyer to the morgue fridge. "Right next to the lunch menu, prince."
You buy a used tuxedo at a client's estate sale. There's a lottery ticket in the pocket. It still loses.
`4Somebody steals your OPEN sign. `$Business is unaffected, which is the sad part.
A pigeon gets into the chapel and keeps landing on the deceased. The family calls it a sign. You call it a pigeon.
Old Man Withers stops in to measure your caskets "for later". He leaves a fingerprint on every one.
Your only suit splits at the seat as you bow at a graveside. The widow laughs for the first time in weeks.
You sell the gold fillings out of your own mouth to make rent. You smile less now. It suits the job.
You find the old professor's notes in Morty's ribcage. Mostly recipes. One for embalming, two for chili.
A man in a hurry asks if you do drive-through viewings. You do now.
Augustus Mourne of Mourne & Sons leaves a fruit basket on your step. The card says "Welcome to the business. It won't last." The fruit is wax.
Dr. Grimble, the county coroner, starts sending you his overflow. Most of it comes with a sticky note: "Sorry about the smell."
Inspector Mudge peers through your front window, writes something down and leaves. You don't sleep for two nights.
Lucius Vane sends over a bottle of something dark from the Reaper Club, with a note: "For later." You decide later can wait.
You catch Ned and Rollo Mourne going through your trash for client lists. They find your "gag" photographs instead and run.

`4Elijah offers you a "loyalty discount" on caskets. `$It turns out the loyalty is to Elijah.
Father Smyth sends you a grieving widow and a note: "She has money. Be gentle. Lemon bars Sunday."
`4A rival leaves a flaming bag on your doorstep. `$You stamp it out. It was exactly what you feared.
The Deathville Enquirer lists you under People Who Smell Funny. Any press is good press.
You hire a teenage organist who only knows one song. It is the song from the ice cream truck.
Morty wins Employee of the Month again. The living staff are talking about a union.
A rival's hearse tails yours to a pickup. You take the long way. Through a car wash. Twice.
June starts saving you a table at Yang's. It's next to the bathroom, but it's a table.
Golden Oaks Retirement Home invites you to bingo night. You slip a business card under every card.
`4Your new casket polish turns out to be flammable. `$The Twins send you a thank-you card.
`4A rival spreads a rumor that you reuse caskets. `$You only did that the one time.
Cousin Sal drops off a body in a shower curtain with a note: "NATURAL CAUSES (TRUST ME)".
A high school class tours your parlor. Three faint. One asks if you're hiring.
Your hearse gets a ticket outside the hospital. The Nurse tears it up. "Professional courtesy, prince."
Mr. Yang sends a free Lucky Sparrow "for my most reliable delivery address". You have never felt so seen.
The bank Teller approves your small business loan, then explains the interest rate very slowly, twice.
A widow tries to return her husband because the casket "washes him out". You swap the casket. Store credit only.
A parlor in Blaine steals your slogan, "You Kill 'Em, We Chill 'Em." You send them a strongly worded wreath.
`4The embalming room drain backs up during a viewing. `$The organist plays louder. It doesn't help.
A jogger collapses outside your door. You are first on the scene, with a brochure.
You buy a used cremation oven from a pizza place in Blaine. Everyone comes out a little crispy and smelling of oregano.
`4Your brother-in-law asks for a job. `$You make him a pallbearer. He drops the end with the feet.
The health inspector finds a mouse in the cold room. You point out it's dead, which is his department's problem.
A rival's grand reopening is rained out. You stand across the street with an umbrella, smiling.
Old Man Withers comes in for his monthly price check and haggles over a plot he "won't need until 2050".
Someone keys GHOUL into your hearse. You add it to the gold lettering. It tests well.
A chain letter says you'll die in seven days unless you forward it. You forward it to every rival in town.
`4The church choir rehearses in your chapel. `$Three sopranos hit a note so high a casket lid pops open.
`4A stranger in a trench coat buys every black rose in town. `$You're out of roses until Thursday.
The Enquirer prints your first five-star review: "Lost my husband, found a great deal."
The Garden Club rules your DEAD? CALL US. lawn sign in poor taste. Calls double.
You start a frequent mourner card. Bury nine relatives, the tenth gets a free carnation.
`4Mourne & Sons runs a newspaper ad: "Our caskets have bottoms." `$Business dips while people wonder about yours.
Dr. Grimble rules a death "natural causes, eventually" and sends the family straight to you. You send him a ham.
Inspector Mudge fails Mourne & Sons for "excessive smiling in a mortuary". You frame the clipping.
Nurse Gertie lets slip that the Mournes tip her twice what you do. You start tipping her three times what you do.
`4You lose a hand of cards to Lucius Vane at the Reaper Club. `$He lets you keep the hand. He keeps your watch.

A major duststorm shuts down Deathsville for awhile. Apparently, even death can take a holiday.
The local bar introduces new 80-proof barley wine. Locals mistake it for regular beer. DWI incidents skyrocket.
The Mayor asks you to cut the ribbon at the new cemetery. He keeps the scissors and has you hold the ribbon.
A tax auditor spends a week in your office and finds nothing. The books were in a casket and he wouldn't open it.
`4A second auditor arrives to audit the first audit. `$This one opens caskets.
A country singer from Blaine dies in the county. His fans fill your lot with pickup trucks and candles.
You hire a publicist. She calls you "the people's undertaker" and bills you extra for the word "people".
Your face goes up on a billboard over the highway. Two accidents that week. You call that synergy.
A widow sues because her husband looked "too happy" in the casket. The jury takes one look and sides with you.
A rival offers to buy you out for a sack of cash and a used hearse. You laugh until security checks on you.
The Enquirer names you Undertaker of the Year: "Smells Fine Up Close."
You put a marble fountain in the lobby. Mourners throw coins in it. You keep the coins.
`4Your gold-plated name plaque is stolen. `$Then the screws. Then, somehow, the wall.
Father Smyth asks you to pay for the church roof. You agree, if the bell rings twice for every one of your funerals.
`4The Twins buy a crate of matches `$and give the clerk your name for the receipt.
You start wearing sunglasses indoors. Families take it as respect for their grief. It's for the hangover.
A soap actress from Blaine wants her poodle buried in your gold casket. You charge the human rate. She tips.
`4Elijah offers you the "executive" price on caskets. `$You pay double and he lets you call him Eli.
You hire a man to applaud when you enter a room. He also cries at funerals, for a small extra fee.
A rival's star embalmer defects to your parlor. She brings her own recipes.
The Mayor's campaign asks for a donation. You give generously and he names a pothole after you.
You give the commencement speech at Spirit University: "Everybody Dies, So Charge Accordingly." Standing ovation.
`4A funeral chain from Blaine makes a hostile takeover bid. `$Their lawyers wear better suits than your clients.
`4You buy a yacht and name it The Final Voyage. `$It sinks on its first one.
Your portrait for the lobby arrives. The painter made you look like one of the clients. People say it's a good likeness.
Morty gets a fan club at the high school. You sell signed photos. He signs with an X.
Dinner at the Mayor's mansion. He asks how much a hole costs per foot, "for a friend". You quote high.
The county makes you acting coroner while the real one is on vacation. You rule every death "great for business".
Your accountant dies. You give him your best funeral and bill the estate for every expense he ever padded.
A documentary crew films your parlor. They agree not to film the embalming, the basement or your face.
`4Your monogrammed caskets are recalled. `$The monogram was yours.
A millionaire wants to be buried in his sports car. You dig the hole wider and bill by the cubic foot.
The Nurse says the hospital now tells patients they'll be "in good hands", then says your name. She means it nicely.
`4Inspectors find your Eternal Flame is a gas leak.
A rival undertaker dies. You send flowers to the widow, then a brochure, then an invoice for the flowers.
June says something nice to you at Yang's. You both pretend it didn't happen.
Cousin Sal shows up in a new sports car and wants to "go into business". You do not ask which business.
Augustus Mourne offers to buy your parlor "for the land". You tell him the land is full. He laughs for the first time since 1958.
Dr. Grimble takes a week off. His stand-in rules everything "a bit of a mystery". Families come to you for answers. You sell them caskets.
`4Inspector Mudge finds your second basement. `$You didn't know you had a second basement either.
The Mourne boys race you down Dead Man's Curve in their hearse. You win. They meet the Curve. You get the funerals.
Lucius Vane asks you to "look after" a sealed casket for a week. It hums at night. You charge him storage.

entries.title: DEATH WITH DIGNITY
entries.message: 20 percent off Gold Coffins at Di-Mart! For a comfortable eternal lay, come see us today!

entries.title: NEW SPEED LIMIT SPEEDS DEATH
entries.message: Maybe 55 in a residential is bad. "We should've known people can't dodge cars," admits the Department of Transportion.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the DMV.\n\n`$"We heard you give bulk discounts..."
entries.addLog: `7DEATH CARE PROVIDER CHOSEN\n`^The Department of Transportation has issued a statement declaring *HOME* the official location for today's services. *NAME* will be on hand for counseling.

entries.title: MIXED UP VIAGRA MEDICATION IN RETIREMENT HOME
entries.message: "It's like a stabbing ... but different," comments the coroner's office.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's Golden Oaks Retirement Home.\n\n`$"We've got some bodies for you..."
entries.addLog: `7FUNERAL HOME CHOSEN\n`^Golden Oaks Retirement Home has announced that *NAME* from *HOME* will be hosting services for the recently departed.

entries.title: A BURGER TO DIE FOR
entries.message: Ecoli outbreak hits Bill's Big Burger leaving many dead or just puking a lot.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe president of Bill's Big Burger walks in.\n\n`$"Let's make a deal..."
entries.addLog: `7BURGER CONTRACT SIGNED\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* has been signed exclusive rights to the Bill's Big Burger  related deaths.  There will be a buffet.

entries.title: ENTIRE SOCCER TEAM KICKS COLLECTIVE BUCKET
entries.message: Plane crash kills 15 people.  Some funeral parlor is going to be in for some big business.
entries.giveRandom: `wA soccer coach brings in 15 dead people - and he wants them all embalmed!
entries.addLog: `7LOCAL PARLOR SCORES\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* will host the funeral and memorial service of the brave 15 soccer players who ended life so tragicially.

entries.title: ZOO ANIMALS ESCAPE, SEEK REVENGE ON HUMANS AND COTTON CANDY
entries.message: "Now their rage is out of the cage," says local australian zookeeper.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe chairman of your local zoo walks in with a black garbage bag.\n\n`$"Please bury this.  ASAP."
entries.addLog: `7AUSTRALIAN ZOOKEEPER MAULED\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* will be hosting services today.

entries.title: THE BIG ONE HITS
entries.message: An earthquake measuring 8.6 on the Richter scale shook things up today.  Families have banded together to locate a death care facility that will offer a package deal.
entries.giveRandom: `wA large truck parks out front and a group of people come inside.\n\n`$"What we really want is one really large grave..."
entries.addLog: `7EARTHQUAKE TRAGEDY HAS BRIGHT SIDE\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* has allowed the victims to purchase one rather large grave together for a discounted per person price.

entries.title: COMPETITION IS FIERCE IN FUNERAL INDUSTRY
entries.message: "There just aren't enough bodies to go around.  Some of these places will die off," admits Mayor.

entries.title: MANY DEAD AFTER PLAYING THEIR ONLINE GAMES TOO LONG
entries.message: "All they wanted was another level, what they got was death," comments Police Commissioner.

entries.title: LOCAL PIZZA COMPANY SCREWS UP BIGTIME
entries.message: "If they didn't eat the pizza in under 30 minutes they would die.  Bad cheese indeed," reports some dude.

entries.title: MAN KILLED BY NEW LASER PRINTER
entries.message: "He thought it was a xerox machine and was trying to photocopy his ass," explains his manager.

entries.title: SNAKEHEAD FISH MENACE STRIKES DEATHSVILLE
entries.message: "At long last, our quiet community has been distrupted by these air-breathing, sword-wielding ninja fish. God help us all," said the mayor at a recent press conference.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the Hospital.\n\n`$"More fish fatalities for you, *NAME*."
entries.addLog: `7*HOME*'S SUCCESS LINKED TO SNAKEHEAD FISH\n`^*NAME* says "God bless those carniverous Asian fish."

entries.title: AREA YOUTH AVOID SUN, FRESH AIR
entries.message: Many of Deathsville's young aren't playing baseball or street hockey these days. Instead, they rush home from school on to their computers to get their daily fix of FUNERAL QUEST. When will the madness end?

entries.title: LEGISLATOR PASSES TAX BREAK FOR MORTICIANS
entries.message: Deathsville's funeral parlors are filled with glee today at the news of the tax break. Said one owner, "They said I was a freak for becoming a mortician. Who's laughing now?"

entries.title: DEAD MAN'S LAST WORDS: "I CAN'T BELIEVE IT WASN'T BUTTER"
entries.message: A mixup at the diary processing plant led to a lethal dose of cleaning fluids entering the butter production unit. Plant Manager George Toole offered his apologies to Deathsville's many affected families. "Come down to the factory and we'll give you new butter."

entries.title: GREEN METEOR SHOWER BRINGS RECORD CROWDS
entries.message: Last night's highly distinctive eerie green meteor shower dazzled area spectators last night. "It was the prettiest thing I ever done seen," said Emma Lou Harrison who awoke this morning totally blind.

entries.title: FREAKY KID SEES "DEAD PEOPLE"
entries.message: Area nerd claims to see "dead people" all around him during his daily routines. "Of course he does, " said his mother. "We run a funeral parlor."

entries.title: AREA POETS, SENSITIVES LANGUOR IN DELIRIUM
entries.message: Medical experts are dumbfounded at the record number of area residents who have taken ill this Hallowmas. Most of those afflicted are artists of some sort. One man, a young poet, has sculped a blasphemous, basalt figurine with a tentacled head and a bloated, rugose body backed with bat-like wings. When questioned, Father Smyth said "this can't be good."

entries.title: THEATRE FIRE KILLS DOZENS
entries.message: The popular theatrical adaptation of the movie "BackDraft" came to deadly conclusion last night in neighboring town Blaine when the special effects got out of control.

entries.title: AREA TEENAGERS UNMASK "ZOMBIE SCARECROW"
entries.message: Before a disbelieving sheriff, four area youths removed the mask of the so-called "Zombie Scarecrow," who turned out to be none other than Old Man Withers. According to one of the young sleuths, Withers "like wanted to frighten the farmers away from the corn field so he could make off with the buried treasure."

entries.title: SOME OF AREA DEAD EVIL, MENACING
entries.message: A local professor's cabin, located in a remote wooded area, was the scene of hair-whitening terror last night as the recording of demon-resurrection passages were unwittingly played aloud by a curious area youth. It was later learned that the professor and his wife had been overcome already by the resuscitated evil when the recordings were  first made. Emergency personnel were unable to reach the cabin, due to a bizzare bridge accident.
entries.giveRandom: `wYour answering machine has the message:\n\n`$Bring the SUV hearse up to the haunted cabin. We got bodies.
entries.addLog: *HOME* discreetly removes the bodies from the haunted cabin, woodshed.

entries.title: NEW UNDERTAKERS FLOOD DEATHVILLE
entries.message: "Every week somebody hangs out a shingle. Every month somebody gets buried under one," says the Mayor, who has asked for a cut of both.

entries.title: ZOO ACQUIRES "MOSTLY TAME" TIGER
entries.message: Deathville Zoo director Hank Pruitt says the new tiger "has only eaten one keeper, and that was during orientation." Visitors are asked not to wear meat-scented cologne.

entries.title: BILL'S BIG BURGER LAUNCHES THE QUADRUPLE BYPASS
entries.message: "Four patties, four cheeses and a fried egg where the bun should be," says owner Bill. "In Blaine it's legally a weapon. Here it's lunch."
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's Bill's Big Burger.\n\n`$"We need a guy for... customer feedback. The quiet kind."
entries.addLog: `7BURGER FEEDBACK HANDLED\n`^*NAME* of *HOME* has quietly collected Bill's Big Burger's first Quadruple Bypass reviewers. Coupons were handed out at the graveside.

entries.title: WITHERS DENIES SCARECROW COMEBACK
entries.message: "I am retired from scaring," says Old Man Withers, 83, speaking to reporters from the middle of a cornfield while wearing the mask.

entries.title: HEAT WAVE: ICE CREAM SALES AND FUNERALS BOTH UP
entries.message: The thermometer outside City Hall melted Tuesday. "Drink water, stay inside, and pre-plan," advises the county, in that order.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's Golden Oaks Retirement Home.\n\n`$"The air conditioning broke on Sunday. Bring the big hearse."
entries.addLog: `7HEAT WAVE TOLL\n`^*NAME* of *HOME* has been called to Golden Oaks Retirement Home. Families are asked to bring fans, and checkbooks.

entries.title: MAYOR UNVEILS STATUE OF MAYOR
entries.message: "Children need to know what a leader looks like," says the Mayor of the eleven-foot bronze, paid for out of the cemetery fund. "The dead don't vote. Mostly."

entries.title: DI-MART: BURY ONE, GET ONE FREE
entries.message: "Limit one per family per day," says Di-Mart clerk Elijah, who shoppers report did not blink once the entire weekend.

entries.title: LAKE BLEAK SWIMMING SEASON OPENS
entries.message: "The lifeguard is new and very enthusiastic," says the parks department. "He can almost swim."

entries.title: CHURCH BAKE SALE HOSPITALIZES TWELVE
entries.message: Father Smyth blames "a bad batch of lemon bars" and "possibly the Lord's will". The surviving lemon bars are now half price.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's Father Smyth.\n\n`$"About the lemon bars. Discretion, please. A lot of discretion."
entries.addLog: `7CHURCH CHOOSES PARLOR\n`^Father Smyth has asked *NAME* of *HOME* to handle the bake sale victims quietly. Very quietly.

entries.title: SPIRIT UNIVERSITY OPENS MORTUARY WING
entries.message: "Ninety percent of our graduates find work within a year," says the Dean. "The other ten percent, we find in the lab."

entries.title: NEW BYPASS NAMED "DEAD MAN'S CURVE" BY POPULAR VOTE
entries.message: Highway engineers call the name "premature". Residents call it "confident". Two undertakers have already bought the billboard space.

entries.title: LOCAL MAN EATS 40 HOT DOGS, WINS TROPHY, DIES
entries.message: "He was so proud," says his widow. "For about four minutes." The trophy will be buried with him, at his request, in his hand.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the County Fair committee.\n\n`$"We need a casket shaped like a trophy. Or a hot dog. Your call."
entries.addLog: `7FAIR CHAMPION LAID TO REST\n`^*NAME* of *HOME* buries the hot dog champion with full honors. Mustard was served.

entries.title: TELLER OF THE MONTH, NINTH YEAR RUNNING
entries.message: Deathville Savings has again named its teller Employee of the Month. "Nobody else applied," she explains, slowly, as if to a child.

entries.title: HOSPITAL LAUNCHES PATIENT LOYALTY CARD
entries.message: "Your tenth visit is free," says the Nurse. "Not many make it to ten, but it's the thought that counts."

entries.title: PALE HORSE CAFE ADDS "LAST MEAL" SPECIAL
entries.message: Steak, pie and a priest on request. "Business is booming," says the owner. "Repeat business, not so much."

entries.title: ELM STREET POTHOLE SWALLOWS SECOND SEDAN
entries.message: The Mayor promises to fill the pothole "right after the election". The sedan's owner is listed as "somewhere down there".

entries.title: TWINS SPOTTED AT HARDWARE STORE
entries.message: A clerk reports the Twins bought forty gallons of lighter fluid and asked, at exactly the same time, whether it came in "extra".

entries.title: CEMETERY PLOTS NOW PRICIER THAN HOUSES
entries.message: "At least the neighbors are quiet," said one buyer. Realtors are reportedly digging up their own back yards to get in on the market.

entries.title: CARNIVAL IN TOWN, FERRIS WHEEL INSPECTED "BY EYE"
entries.message: "I looked at it real hard," says the county inspector. "It looked fine. Mostly round."
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the carnival.\n\n`$"The wheel came off. It rolled a real long way. Bring several hearses."
entries.addLog: `7CARNIVAL TRAGEDY\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* collects the Ferris wheel riders from three counties. Free cotton candy for every mourner.

entries.title: FIRST FROST KILLS DAISIES, TWO GARDENERS
entries.message: "They wouldn't come in without the daisies," says a neighbor. The daisies have been composted. The gardeners are still being discussed.

entries.title: MOURNE & SONS MARKS 70 YEARS
entries.message: "Three generations of Mournes have buried this town, and we intend to bury the rest of it," says Augustus Mourne, cutting a black ribbon with a shovel. His sons Ned and Rollo handed out free thermometers.

entries.title: CORONER MOVES OFFICE, AGAIN
entries.message: Dr. Ignatius Grimble has moved the county morgue from the Di-Mart freezer aisle to the back of the bowling alley. "Better ventilation, worse shoes," he says.

entries.title: INSPECTOR MUDGE NAMED EMPLOYEE OF THE MONTH
entries.message: City Hall honors Inspector Mudge for closing eleven restaurants, two daycares and a lemonade stand. "The lemonade had pulp," he said. "Unlabeled pulp."

entries.title: DEATH WITH DIGNITY
entries.message: 20 percent off Gold Coffins at Di-Mart! For a comfortable eternal lay, come see us today!

entries.title: NEW SPEED LIMIT SPEEDS DEATH
entries.message: Maybe 55 in a residential is bad. "We should've known people can't dodge cars," admits the Department of Transportion.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the DMV.\n\n`$"We heard you give bulk discounts..."
entries.addLog: `7DEATH CARE PROVIDER CHOSEN\n`^The Department of Transportation has issued a statement declaring *HOME* the official location for today's services. *NAME* will be on hand for counseling.

entries.title: MIXED UP VIAGRA MEDICATION IN RETIREMENT HOME
entries.message: "It's like a stabbing ... but different," comments the coroner's office.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's Golden Oaks Retirement Home.\n\n`$"We've got some bodies for you..."
entries.addLog: `7FUNERAL HOME CHOSEN\n`^Golden Oaks Retirement Home has announced that *NAME* from *HOME* will be hosting services for the recently departed.

entries.title: A BURGER TO DIE FOR
entries.message: Ecoli outbreak hits Bill's Big Burger leaving many dead or just puking a lot.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe president of Bill's Big Burger walks in.\n\n`$"Let's make a deal..."
entries.addLog: `7BURGER CONTRACT SIGNED\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* has been signed exclusive rights to the Bill's Big Burger  related deaths.  There will be a buffet.

entries.title: ENTIRE SOCCER TEAM KICKS COLLECTIVE BUCKET
entries.message: Plane crash kills 15 people.  Some funeral parlor is going to be in for some big business.
entries.giveRandom: `wA soccer coach brings in 15 dead people - and he wants them all embalmed!
entries.addLog: `7LOCAL PARLOR SCORES\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* will host the funeral and memorial service of the brave 15 soccer players who ended life so tragicially.

entries.title: ZOO ANIMALS ESCAPE, SEEK REVENGE ON HUMANS AND COTTON CANDY
entries.message: "Now their rage is out of the cage," says local australian zookeeper.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe chairman of your local zoo walks in with a black garbage bag.\n\n`$"Please bury this.  ASAP."
entries.addLog: `7AUSTRALIAN ZOOKEEPER MAULED\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* will be hosting services today.

entries.title: THE BIG ONE HITS
entries.message: An earthquake measuring 8.6 on the Richter scale shook things up today.  Families have banded together to locate a death care facility that will offer a package deal.
entries.giveRandom: `wA large truck parks out front and a group of people come inside.\n\n`$"What we really want is one really large grave..."
entries.addLog: `7EARTHQUAKE TRAGEDY HAS BRIGHT SIDE\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* has allowed the victims to purchase one rather large grave together for a discounted per person price.

entries.title: COMPETITION IS FIERCE IN FUNERAL INDUSTRY
entries.message: "There just aren't enough bodies to go around.  Some of these places will die off," admits Mayor.

entries.title: MANY DEAD AFTER PLAYING THEIR ONLINE GAMES TOO LONG
entries.message: "All they wanted was another level, what they got was death," comments Police Commissioner.

entries.title: LOCAL PIZZA COMPANY SCREWS UP BIGTIME
entries.message: "If they didn't eat the pizza in under 30 minutes they would die.  Bad cheese indeed," reports some dude.

entries.title: MAN KILLED BY NEW LASER PRINTER
entries.message: "He thought it was a xerox machine and was trying to photocopy his ass," explains his manager.

entries.title: SNAKEHEAD FISH MENACE STRIKES DEATHSVILLE
entries.message: "At long last, our quiet community has been distrupted by these air-breathing, sword-wielding ninja fish. God help us all," said the mayor at a recent press conference.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the Hospital.\n\n`$"More fish fatalities for you, *NAME*."
entries.addLog: `7*HOME*'S SUCCESS LINKED TO SNAKEHEAD FISH\n`^*NAME* says "God bless those carniverous Asian fish."

entries.title: AREA YOUTH AVOID SUN, FRESH AIR
entries.message: Many of Deathsville's young aren't playing baseball or street hockey these days. Instead, they rush home from school on to their computers to get their daily fix of FUNERAL QUEST. When will the madness end?

entries.title: LEGISLATOR PASSES TAX BREAK FOR MORTICIANS
entries.message: Deathsville's funeral parlors are filled with glee today at the news of the tax break. Said one owner, "They said I was a freak for becoming a mortician. Who's laughing now?"

entries.title: DEAD MAN'S LAST WORDS: "I CAN'T BELIEVE IT WASN'T BUTTER"
entries.message: A mixup at the diary processing plant led to a lethal dose of cleaning fluids entering the butter production unit. Plant Manager George Toole offered his apologies to Deathsville's many affected families. "Come down to the factory and we'll give you new butter."

entries.title: GREEN METEOR SHOWER BRINGS RECORD CROWDS
entries.message: Last night's highly distinctive eerie green meteor shower dazzled area spectators last night. "It was the prettiest thing I ever done seen," said Emma Lou Harrison who awoke this morning totally blind.

entries.title: FREAKY KID SEES "DEAD PEOPLE"
entries.message: Area nerd claims to see "dead people" all around him during his daily routines. "Of course he does, " said his mother. "We run a funeral parlor."

entries.title: AREA POETS, SENSITIVES LANGUOR IN DELIRIUM
entries.message: Medical experts are dumbfounded at the record number of area residents who have taken ill this Hallowmas. Most of those afflicted are artists of some sort. One man, a young poet, has sculped a blasphemous, basalt figurine with a tentacled head and a bloated, rugose body backed with bat-like wings. When questioned, Father Smyth said "this can't be good."

entries.title: THEATRE FIRE KILLS DOZENS
entries.message: The popular theatrical adaptation of the movie "BackDraft" came to deadly conclusion last night in neighboring town Blaine when the special effects got out of control.

entries.title: AREA TEENAGERS UNMASK "ZOMBIE SCARECROW"
entries.message: Before a disbelieving sheriff, four area youths removed the mask of the so-called "Zombie Scarecrow," who turned out to be none other than Old Man Withers. According to one of the young sleuths, Withers "like wanted to frighten the farmers away from the corn field so he could make off with the buried treasure."

entries.title: SOME OF AREA DEAD EVIL, MENACING
entries.message: A local professor's cabin, located in a remote wooded area, was the scene of hair-whitening terror last night as the recording of demon-resurrection passages were unwittingly played aloud by a curious area youth. It was later learned that the professor and his wife had been overcome already by the resuscitated evil when the recordings were  first made. Emergency personnel were unable to reach the cabin, due to a bizzare bridge accident.
entries.giveRandom: `wYour answering machine has the message:\n\n`$Bring the SUV hearse up to the haunted cabin. We got bodies.
entries.addLog: *HOME* discreetly removes the bodies from the haunted cabin, woodshed.

entries.title: BILL'S BIG BURGER RECALLS QUADRUPLE BYPASS
entries.message: "We are pulling it from the menu out of respect," says Bill. "Also the health department took the grill."
entries.giveRandom: `wThe president of Bill's Big Burger walks in, sweating.\n\n`$"Some of the recall came too late..."
entries.addLog: `7BURGER CHAIN SIGNS UNDERTAKER\n`^Bill's Big Burger has named *NAME* of *HOME* its official funeral partner. Every mourner gets a coupon.

entries.title: ZOO TIGER ESCAPES, RETURNS FOR DINNER
entries.message: "He came back on his own, and very full," says zoo director Hank Pruitt. A head count of the night staff is under way.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe zoo director walks in with a shovel and a sad face.\n\n`$"We found most of the night watchman."
entries.addLog: `7TIGER TRAGEDY\n`^*NAME* of *HOME* will bury the zoo's night watchman, and whatever else turns up in the tiger enclosure.

entries.title: DENTIST DORIS FENWICK TO RUN FOR MAYOR
entries.message: Retired dentist Doris Fenwick challenges the Mayor on a platform of "fewer statues". The Mayor responded by unveiling a statue.

entries.title: ZOMBIE SCARECROW RETURNS; WITHERS "AT BINGO"
entries.message: A figure in a scarecrow mask terrorized farmers Thursday. Old Man Withers says he was at bingo. Bingo staff confirm he left early, "shedding straw".

entries.title: BLAINE: OUR CEMETERY IS BETTER
entries.message: Blaine's mayor calls Deathville's cemetery "a gravel lot with feelings". Our Mayor fired back that Blaine is "a cemetery that hasn't been told yet".

entries.title: DI-MART RECALLS DURAREST (TM) NECK BRACE
entries.message: "It works perfectly," says Elijah. "The problem is people keep wearing it while they're alive." Refunds are available in store credit, for caskets.

entries.title: FLU SEASON ARRIVES EARLY, PLANS TO STAY
entries.message: Doctors urge residents to wash their hands and avoid the bingo hall. Residents have agreed to the first one.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the Nurse.\n\n`$"Hi, prince. The flu ward made you a list. It's a long list."
entries.addLog: `7FLU WARD TURNS TO LOCAL PARLOR\n`^The hospital has sent its flu cases to *NAME* of *HOME*. The Nurse says *NAME* "has a lovely bedside manner, for after".

entries.title: CHURCH BINGO NIGHT ENDS IN BRAWL
entries.message: "Somebody called bingo on last week's card," says Father Smyth. "Then somebody threw a folding chair. This can't be good."
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's Golden Oaks Retirement Home.\n\n`$"Bingo got out of hand. Bring chairs. And several boxes."
entries.addLog: `7BINGO BRAWL VICTIMS LAID TO REST\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* handles the bingo brawl. The winning card will be buried with its owner.

entries.title: ENQUIRER ASKS: ARE UNDERTAKERS HAPPIER?
entries.message: A Deathville Enquirer survey finds 100 percent of local funeral directors "satisfied with demand". The other questions were left blank.

entries.title: LAKE BLEAK MONSTER SPOTTED
entries.message: Fisherman Earl Dunlop describes the creature as "big, green, and wearing my brother's hat". Earl's brother has not been seen since the fishing trip.

entries.title: MAYOR PROMISES "A FUNERAL IN EVERY POT"
entries.message: Critics point out the slogan means nothing. The Mayor says it means "jobs". Doris Fenwick says it means "he needs a dentist".

entries.title: FOG ROLLS IN, STAYS A WEEK
entries.message: Visibility on Dead Man's Curve is under a foot. Drivers are advised to use their horns, their lights and their prayers.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the highway patrol.\n\n`$"Pileup on Dead Man's Curve. Bring the long hearse."
entries.addLog: `7CURVE LIVES UP TO ITS NAME\n`^Highway patrol thanks *NAME* of *HOME* for clearing Dead Man's Curve in record time.

entries.title: UNDERTAKER'S CAT RUNS FOR CITY COUNCIL
entries.message: The cat, owned by an unnamed local undertaker, is polling ahead of every human candidate. "It's the eyes," says one voter. "It's seen things."

entries.title: CASKET PRICES SOAR AFTER LUMBER MILL FIRE
entries.message: Investigators are questioning the Twins, who deny everything at exactly the same time and in the same words.

entries.title: FREE CPR CLASS CANCELLED FOR LACK OF INTEREST
entries.message: "We had the dummy and everything," says the Nurse. "The dummy showed up. Nobody else did."

entries.title: POLKA FESTIVAL DRAWS RECORD CROWD, RECORD HEATSTROKE
entries.message: "The accordions just kept going," says one survivor. "Nobody could hear the ambulances."
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the Polka Festival committee.\n\n`$"Our headliner collapsed mid-song. He'd want an accordion on the casket."
entries.addLog: `7POLKA KING SQUEEZED INTO CASKET\n`^*NAME* of *HOME* buries the polka festival's headliner. The band plays on, over the hole.

entries.title: WITHERS BUYS NEW TEETH
entries.message: "These babies will outlive every undertaker in town," said Old Man Withers, demonstrating by biting a fence post.

entries.title: PSYCH PROFESSOR "CAN READ YOUR MIND"
entries.message: "Most of you are thinking about money," the Spirit University professor told the press. "Especially the undertakers. I can hear them from here."

entries.title: YANG'S PROMISES DELIVERY IN 30 MINUTES
entries.message: "Anywhere in Deathville, thirty minutes," says Mr. Yang. "Tiger, sparrow, it does not matter. My car is very fast and my conscience is very quiet."

entries.title: POLICE BUY NEW SQUAD CAR, CRASH IT
entries.message: "It's a learning curve," says the chief of the Deathville PD. "Specifically, Dead Man's Curve."

entries.title: SPEED DATING NIGHT AT GOLDEN OAKS
entries.message: Three engagements, two broken hips and one funeral. "A typical Tuesday," says management.

entries.title: BILL'S BIG BURGER FIGHTS BACK WITH FREE REFILLS
entries.message: "Unlimited gravy," says Bill. "We're not saying it's safe. We're saying it's unlimited."

entries.title: MOURNE BOYS COME TO BLOWS AT CHURCH
entries.message: Ned and Rollo Mourne fought on Sunday over who would carry the front of a casket. The deceased, a Mr. Harold Pine, was dropped twice. Father Smyth has asked both boys to "find another God".
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the Pine family.\n\n`$"Can you bury Harold properly? Nobody has dropped him in a while and we'd like to keep it that way."
entries.addLog: `7PINE FAMILY SWITCHES PARLORS\n`^*NAME* of *HOME* has reburied Harold Pine. He was not dropped once.

entries.title: CORONER: "IT'S ALWAYS THE APPLIANCES"
entries.message: Dr. Grimble's annual report names household appliances the county's leading cause of death for the ninth year running. "Lock your freezers," he advises. "And never turn your back on a toaster."

entries.title: LUCIUS VANE DENIES OWNING THE NIGHT
entries.message: "I simply keep late hours," says the owner of the Reaper Club, who was photographed at noon casting no shadow. City Hall has renewed his liquor license "for as long as he likes".

entries.title: ST. MORTIMER'S BELLS DROWN OUT WITHERS' NOISE COMPLAINT
entries.message: Old Man Withers filed a complaint about the rebuilt bells, and the bells rang through the hearing. "I could not hear myself being right," he said. The complaint has been filed under B, for Bells.

entries.title: CHOIR PRACTISES ON LEVEL 3 OF THE GARAGE 'FOR THE ACOUSTICS'
entries.message: The choir has moved into Vane's garage, where a sedan on Level 2 has been joining in on its alarm. Father Smyth says it is the best the Kyrie has ever sounded, and also the cheapest he has ever paid for parking.

entries.title: BIGTOWN SENDS THANK-YOU CARD, THEN INVOICE
entries.message: The card thanked Deathville for its business. The invoice charged Deathville for the card. Nurse Gertie has pinned both to the fridge, next to a drawing of a cough.

entries.title: MORTY HOLDS CITY HALL DOOR FOR FOUR HOURS; NOBODY COMPLAINS
entries.message: A man with a clipboard arrived at nine and was held at the door until one. "I thought it was a hold-up," he said. "It was Morty." The man has joined the fan club's committee.

entries.title: MORTY'S FIRST DECREE SIGNED WITH AN X
entries.message: The Honorary Mayor declared the first Tuesday of the month "a day of leaning". The council is reading the decree for hidden meanings. So far it has found none, and several leaves.

entries.title: RACCOON IN HAT PROMOTED TO NIGHT WATCHMAN'S ASSISTANT
entries.message: The raccoon was given a lantern, a whistle and a smaller hat for night shifts. The watchman says the raccoon is "a natural", and has asked that nobody mention how.

entries.title: RACCOON IN A HAT SPOTTED IN ROW C, WEARING A SECOND HAT
entries.message: The second hat is larger. Nobody asked where it came from. Nobody asked where the shovel came from either, since the shovel is the church's.

entries.title: ELIJAH'S PLAQUE STOLEN, RETURNED, STOLEN
entries.message: The plaque has now been stolen and returned three times, each time in better condition. Store cameras show Elijah putting it back at 3 a.m., not blinking.

entries.title: DI-MART OPENS 'LEGACY AISLE' FOR OLD PRICES
entries.message: The aisle holds one tin of beans, priced at "historical value". Elijah restocks it hourly and has never been seen arriving or leaving.

entries.title: FIRE BRIGADE DALMATIAN RECEIVES A TINY HELMET
entries.message: The dalmatian who held the line on Elm Street was presented with a helmet by the grateful brigade. The dalmatian ate the helmet. The brigade says that counts as a salute.

entries.title: TWINS SEND ELM STREET A CARD: 'GLAD YOU LIKED IT'
entries.message: The card features a drawing of a birdhouse. The sheriff has asked politely that the Twins stay in Blaine. The Twins replied, at the same time, "we like it here".

entries.title: EVERYONE WHO BET AGAINST WITHERS DEMANDS A PULSE CHECK
entries.message: Withers cooperated and offered his wrist, then his neck, then a mirror to hold under his nose. "Still here," he said. "Check again tomorrow." The bookmakers have set his odds at "ridiculous".

entries.title: WITHERS' EULOGY NOW ON CASSETTE; SIDE B IS A REBUTTAL
entries.message: The tape runs two hours and nine minutes. Di-Mart sells it at the register next to the gum, and Elijah has been seen listening to it without blinking.

entries.title: MAN WITH THE TEETH SPOTTED AT LOCAL PARLOR, 'JUST LOOKING'
entries.message: He measured the carpet and asked about plot income. He left when a staff member offered him a casket "to try on". The casket is still in the lobby, and so is his business card.

entries.title: NURSE GERTIE'S COFFEE MUG BECOMES TOURIST ATTRACTION
entries.message: The mug reads WORLD'S OKAYEST NURSE and has been in service since before the hospital had a roof. A coach party queued for a photo. Gertie made them leave their cups at the door.

entries.title: HEAD NURSE SAL REQUESTS NAME TAG; HOSPITAL PRINTS 'ALSO SAL'
entries.message: His white coat still bears the previous owner's name. The hospital printed the tag in good faith and nobody has had the heart to correct it. Gertie checks it daily, for evidence.

entries.title: DEATH WITH DIGNITY
entries.message: 20 percent off Gold Coffins at Di-Mart! For a comfortable eternal lay, come see us today!

entries.title: NEW SPEED LIMIT SPEEDS DEATH
entries.message: Maybe 55 in a residential is bad. "We should've known people can't dodge cars," admits the Department of Transportion.

entries.title: MAYOR WINS IN A LANDSLIDE. AN ACTUAL ONE.
entries.message: A mudslide buried the polling station along with most of Doris Fenwick's supporters. "Democracy has spoken," says the Mayor.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's City Hall.\n\n`$"Some of the voters need digging out. Sort of."
entries.addLog: `7MAYOR THANKS LOCAL PARLOR\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* buries the Fenwick campaign team. The Mayor sends a fruit basket and a small statue of himself.

entries.title: ZOMBIE SCARECROW UNMASKED. IT'S STILL WITHERS.
entries.message: "I want my cornfield back," says Old Man Withers. "And my mask. That's my good mask." The sheriff has given up and lent him a better one.

entries.title: BILL OF BILL'S BIG BURGER DIES AT HIS OWN GRILL
entries.message: "He died doing what he loved, which was frying things," says his widow. The restaurant will reopen Thursday under the slogan "Still Big".
entries.giveRandom: `wBill's widow walks in holding a spatula.\n\n`$"He wanted to be buried in a bun. Can you do a bun?"
entries.addLog: `7BILL LAID TO REST IN A BUN\n`^*NAME* of *HOME* buries Bill in a sesame-seed casket. The buffet is, of course, burgers.

entries.title: SEASON'S END NEARS: UNDERTAKERS EXHAUSTED, RICH
entries.message: "I haven't slept in a month," says one funeral director. "I have, however, bought a boat."

entries.title: ZOO CLOSES TIGER EXHIBIT, OPENS TIGER MEMORIAL
entries.message: The tiger is fine. The memorial is for everyone else. Zoo director Hank Pruitt will be honored in a separate ceremony, in the reptile house.

entries.title: ASTRONOMER: NOTHING TO WORRY ABOUT IN THE SKY
entries.message: The Spirit University astronomer insists the big glowing thing is a weather balloon. "A very big, very hot weather balloon. Moving very fast. Toward us."

entries.title: METEOR RUMOR SPARKS RUN ON CASKETS
entries.message: "People want to be ready," says Elijah at Di-Mart. "Also, I raised the prices. Also, I am not blinking. I never blink."
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's Di-Mart.\n\n`$"Elijah here. Some customers bought caskets and then panicked. Can you finish the job?"
entries.addLog: `7DI-MART PARTNERS WITH PARLOR\n`^Di-Mart has named *NAME* of *HOME* its preferred undertaker. Elijah could not be reached to blink for comment.

entries.title: CHURCH ROOF FINALLY FIXED, IMMEDIATELY FALLS IN
entries.message: "This can't be good," said Father Smyth, from under it. It was not good.
entries.giveRandom: `wFather Smyth walks in covered in plaster.\n\n`$"The roof came in during the sermon. I need a parlor with a forgiving price list."
entries.addLog: `7ROOF COLLAPSE AT ST. MORBID'S\n`^*NAME* of *HOME* handles the services for the congregation. Lemon bars to follow, sadly.

entries.title: LAKE BLEAK MONSTER IDENTIFIED AS EARL'S BROTHER
entries.message: "He always loved that lake," says Earl Dunlop. "And my hat. I'd like the hat back, if it's all the same."

entries.title: MAYOR SPENDS CEMETERY FUND ON MORE STATUES
entries.message: A third statue of the Mayor now stands on top of the grave of the second. "It's called legacy," he explains.

entries.title: COSTUME PARADE ENDS IN HAYRIDE PILEUP
entries.message: "The tractor was dressed as a ghost," a witness says. "It was very convincing. Nobody saw it coming."
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the Parade committee.\n\n`$"The hayride went into the quarry. Most people were in costume, so check the toe tags twice."
entries.addLog: `7COSTUME PARADE CLEANUP\n`^*NAME* from *HOME* recovers the hayride riders. Several were buried in costume, at their families' request.

entries.title: BLAINE UNDERTAKERS' CONVENTION BANS DEATHVILLE
entries.message: Organizers cite "the incident with the open bar, the hearse and the swimming pool." Nobody from Deathville would comment, but several smiled.

entries.title: HOSPITAL TO NAME WING AFTER TOP UNDERTAKER
entries.message: "We want to honor whoever sends us the nicest thank-you cards," says the Nurse. "And the biggest fruit baskets. Mostly the baskets."

entries.title: WINTER STORM BURIES GOLDEN OAKS
entries.message: Snowdrifts reached the second floor overnight. The bingo game continued by candlelight until the candles ran out.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's Golden Oaks Retirement Home.\n\n`$"The plow just got here. We'll need you. And a ladder."
entries.addLog: `7STORM TOLL CLIMBS\n`^Golden Oaks hires *NAME* of *HOME*. Families thank the plow driver, then *NAME*.

entries.title: THE TWINS OPEN A FIREWORKS STAND
entries.message: "We like to play with fire," they told reporters, together. "Now it's legal. Mostly." The stand is located next to the gas station.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the fire department.\n\n`$"The fireworks stand went up. All of it. The Twins are fine. The customers... bring a bucket."
entries.addLog: `7FIREWORKS STAND EXPLODES\n`^*NAME* of *HOME* buries the Twins' customers. The Twins send a wreath. It is on fire.

entries.title: WITHERS FINALLY PICKS HIS CASKET
entries.message: After 52 years of price-checking, Old Man Withers chose the cheapest wood model. "I'm still not dying," he added. "I just want it on the porch."

entries.title: FINAL STANDINGS NEAR; UNDERTAKERS STOP SLEEPING
entries.message: "I just stand by the phone now," says one. "Sometimes I call the hospital to make sure their phone works."

entries.title: MORTY THE SKELETON VOTED MOST POPULAR RESIDENT
entries.message: Morty beat the Mayor by twelve votes. The Mayor demands a recount, an apology and a statue, not necessarily in that order.

entries.title: ENQUIRER: WHICH UNDERTAKER IS STEALING THE RINGS?
entries.message: Three families report wedding rings missing after open-casket viewings. "The dead don't take jewelry," says the sheriff. "Somebody living does."

entries.title: YANG'S NAMES FORTUNE COOKIE OF THE YEAR
entries.message: "This year's winner: You will be buried by someone cheap," says Mr. Yang. "Very popular. People keep it in their wallet, for the funeral."

entries.title: MOURNE & SONS OPENS DRIVE-THRU VIEWING
entries.message: "Grief on the go," says Augustus Mourne of the new window on Elm Street. Mourners pay their respects without leaving the car. Three have already rear-ended the hearse.
entries.giveRandom: `wThe phone rings - It's the Elm Street traffic office.\n\n`$"There's been a pile-up at the Mourne window. They don't take walk-ins. Or crash-ins."
entries.addLog: `7DRIVE-THRU PILE-UP\n`^*NAME* of *HOME* buries the victims of the Mourne & Sons drive-thru. Augustus Mourne sent a coupon.

entries.title: HEALTH INSPECTOR FAILS HIMSELF
entries.message: Inspector Mudge has cited himself for "unsanitary sandwich storage" in his own desk drawer. "Nobody is above the code," he said, and paid the fine to himself.

entries.title: CORONER WRITES MEMOIR
entries.message: Dr. Ignatius Grimble's book, "Cause Unknown, Probably Cheese", is on sale at Di-Mart. Elijah has read it six times without blinking and says the ending "is very accurate".

entries.title: CURE PARADE RETURNS FOR A SECOND LAP
entries.message: The Mayor's cure parade went around the square a second time "for the people at the back". Attendance was higher on the second lap, owing to the free cough drops.

entries.title: PIGEONS PETITION FOR A PLACE ON THE UNKNOWN UNDERTAKER
entries.message: A flock has applied for the statue's shoulder. The council says the application is under review and the statue is under the pigeons.

entries.title: SOLEMNCORP CEMETERY (FORMERLY CEMETERY) UNVEILS NEW SIGN
entries.message: The new sign was hung above the old sign, which was hung above the older sign. Mourners say it feels like being buried by a spreadsheet.

entries.title: SOLEMNCORP LIQUIDATES: 400 BALLOONS, ONE TELEPHONE
entries.message: The Elm Street branch auction raised eleven dollars. The balloons went to a birthday and the telephone to a man named Ted, who says it has not stopped ringing and is very sorry for his loss.

entries.title: EARL DUNLOP: 'THE FERRY WAS NOT WEARING MY BROTHER'S HAT'
entries.message: Earl says the hat is still missing and that the ferry "never had a head". Lucius Vane's harpoon has been returned to his collection, which now holds four harpoons and no boat.

entries.title: MONSTER FAN CLUB MEETS; MONSTER UNABLE TO ATTEND
entries.message: The club's first newsletter asks members for photographs. The second page is a photograph of a log. The treasurer says the log "has a lot of character".

entries.title: COUNCIL VOTES ON WHETHER THE VOTE COUNTED, FOUR TO ONE
entries.message: The Mayor's office says it will be fine whichever way it goes, which is the same way. The one vote in favor was reported to be a clerical error, and a cousin.

entries.title: MAYOR'S STATUE OF SURVIVAL RULED 'TECHNICALLY A FOUNTAIN'
entries.message: The fourth statue has been fitted with a pump so that it can survive and also spit. The permit office says the water comes out of the medal, and is billing the medal.
